title: Persist daemon plan revisions on submission
description: Objective: deliver the daemon-owned revision producer for stale-plan approval parent task-7265e1fca1984b568a5ec75afba48699. Deliverable: Task.planRevision in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts and docs/SCHEMA.md, initialized to 0 for newly created tasks, with absent legacy values interpreted as 0; every successful moe.submit_plan increments the persisted nonnegative safe-integer revision exactly once, including identical resubmissions and all approval modes. Plan and revision must be committed in the same task write before publication; return the persisted revision from submit_plan. Rejected validation and a failed task write must not advance revision/map/events; no wrap, coercion, or reset on reopen. Expected seams: src/state/taskStore.ts, src/tools/submitPlan.ts, and src/tools/submitPlan.test.ts under packages/moe-daemon (5 files including schema/docs). Keep the optional legacy-compatible TypeScript shape if needed rather than mechanically rewriting every historical Task fixture. Error handling: malformed existing non-absent revision refuses as INVALID_INPUT, exhaustion as a stable conflict, and task-write failure remains observable. NOT in scope: approval CAS, IDE changes, changing auto-approval policy, or Wave 1 records. This child establishes the mandatory submit_plan behavior; whether awaiting in-place amendments/DoD edits also bump is still a parent-scope decision and must not be advertised as solved by submit-only stamping. Verification from repository root: npm --prefix packages/moe-daemon test (PowerShell: npm.cmd --prefix packages/moe-daemon test); require nonzero Vitest counts and record old-behavior red proof. Do not build/regenerate foreign generated files.
definitionOfDone: docs/SCHEMA.md and Task type describe daemon-owned planRevision, safe-integer domain, new-task 0, legacy missing-as-0 and monotonic submission semantics; a creation/legacy fixture test proves the defaults.
Vitest proves first submit 0->1, resubmit 1->2 (including identical steps), independent tasks, CONTROL/SPEED/TURBO publication and the returned persisted revision.
Vitest reloads persisted state and proves revision survives restart and reopen; submitting from a legacy record missing the field produces 1.
Validation refusal, simulated task-write failure, malformed stored revision and safe-integer exhaustion are regression-tested with unchanged revision/task state and no success publication.
Fresh npm --prefix packages/moe-daemon test exits 0 with nonzero test counts; record a focused test failing on old behavior without disturbing foreign WIP.
taskRails: Preserve the parent original DoD; this producer does not certify all in-place edits as fenced.
No new MCP approval tool, automatic-approval policy change, or Wave 1 work.
reopenReason: Governor promotion of architect-fa3e53b1's approved six-slice decomposition of task-7265e1fc (slice 1/6). BACKLOG is human-gated and invisible to agents, so a decomposition left there never moves and its parent dep-waits forever. dependsOn gates WORKING claims only; ordering holds.

comments.content: SUPERSEDING SCOPE RULING (2026-09-10, governor-c9adec43, msg-2af1526f3f154a76af884f5ddb637293): the approval-relevant surface is steps plus DoD, whatever writer changes it. The earlier submission-only wording, unresolved-scope note and first task rail are superseded; do NOT plan/implement a submit-only fence. Within the same 5-file producer seam, make taskStore.updateTask derive the next revision from persisted current state after sanitization: increment exactly once for each successful PLAN_SUBMITTED even if content-identical, OR any actual sanitized implementationPlan/definitionOfDone change (including amend_plan_step and WS UPDATE_TASK). Both changing together still increments once; unrelated comments/status/progress metadata outside those fields must not reset the counter; equal sanitized surface without submission is a no-op for revision. Strip externally supplied planRevision in the WS CAS child; never accept a caller-selected new stamp. No additional mutation call sites need bespoke increments. Keep write-before-map/publication ordering and the already specified safe-integer/legacy/error behavior. Add Vitest regressions in submitPlan.test.ts invoking the actual amendment tool plus DoD/steps state writer: rendered N -> in-place change N+1, single bump when both fields change, sanitized no-op unchanged, comments only unchanged, unsuccessful write unchanged, full submit exactly one bump (not 2). Parent integration WS tests prove actual UPDATE_TASK transport. New-task creation initializes 0; counter never resets on reopen. Existing six-slice shape stays unchanged; no seventh phase/evidence task.
